name: How long does it typically take to complete a Junior ADU project from start to finish?
description: A Junior ADU project typically takes 4-8 months from design to completion, including 2-4 months for permitting and 2-4 months for construction.

mainEntity.name: How long does it typically take to complete a Junior ADU project from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a Junior ADU project can vary, but generally, it takes several months. The design and permitting phase often takes 2-4 months, depending on the complexity of the plans and local city department processing times in areas like Orange or Mission Viejo. Construction itself usually takes an additional 2-4 months. Factors such as material availability, contractor scheduling, and unexpected site conditions can impact the overall duration. Planning for a total of 4-8 months is a reasonable expectation.
